findings.title: Actor-output return
findings.claim: The people's issuing and their intentional works can be read as an actor-output relation: what comes from the people is brought forward for those same people to see, rather than remaining under their control as a merely public display.
findings.mechanism: The focus combines ص د ر source/departure and أَعْمَالَهُمْ intentional works with passive يَرَوْا causing the people to see. The supplied 99:7-8 singular direct-seeing clauses and return/report connections turn the focus's plural showing into an owner-facing feedback loop.
findings.reader_payoff: The verse becomes a hinge from collective emergence to personal encounter with the work that issued from each actor.
findings.containment: This does not assert a literal object leaving the chest, a physical return trajectory, or that every act is morally divided here; the owner-facing arrow is a bounded cross-ayah inference.

epistemic.reason: Trusted published anchors establish the focus relations, while legacy support and supplied cross-ayah connections provide the actor-output and return mechanism with a stated inferential boundary.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi başkasına gösterip onun görmesini sağlama.
branch_activations.carrier: يُرَوْا۟ carries the causative showing of the works to the people.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The works are named as their own, and 99:7-8 supplies the later singular seeing of each worked result.
branch_activations.activation: Passive showing on the focus meets possessive works and the later direct-seeing clauses, changing display into an owner-facing encounter.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The people are made to see outputs attributed back to them.
branch_activations.boundary: No literal visual object, physical route, or exhaustive theory of judgment is claimed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsan ve hayvan gövdesinin boyun altındaki ön bölgesini belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: صَدْرُ carries the registered chest/source image at the focus form.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied inner-content and return/report connections place hidden contents and deeds in an outward-to-owner sequence.
branch_activations.activation: The chest facet contacts the named works and later reporting of deeds, allowing source and output to meet without collapsing the lexical chest sense into anatomy.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The issuing can mark what comes from an inward source before it is made visible to its owner.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not claim that a literal chest opens or that the focus word directly means intention.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: eylem türetme temeli; çıkış yeri veya zamanı
branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekimli eylem biçimlerinin türediği kabul edilen temel sözcük biçimini belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: ص د ر supplies an action/source derivational basis and an issuing point or time.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus names works and the following ayahs individualize the work-result relation.
branch_activations.activation: The source-form facet meets intentional works and individual seeing, making issuing the point at which an action enters accountable visibility.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The people's departure is also the surfacing of action outputs for attribution.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a source relation, not a claim that the morphology alone encodes final judgment.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem anlamı çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: أَعْمَالَهُمْ carries intentionally produced works under possessive attribution.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later singular clauses say that whoever works an atom's weight sees it, and the exertion connection explicitly relates effort to being seen.
branch_activations.activation: Intentional work on the focus meets direct later seeing, so the output is not only reported but returned as an object of the actor's perception.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Each person's work becomes the accountable output encountered by that person.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not by itself specify the moral value, size, or complete inventory of the works.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: gözle ya da içsel kavrayışla görme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus seeing form carries the registered perceptual seeing field alongside its causative facet.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 99:7-8 changes the grammatical scene to each actor directly seeing the result, and the supplied exertion connection confirms a seen outcome.
branch_activations.activation: The direct-seeing facet completes the passive showing by making the actor the recipient of the work's visibility.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The disclosure is perceptual and owner-facing, not merely an external announcement.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made about the modality of seeing beyond the packet's visual or inward-perceptual range.

findings.title: Partitioned accountability
findings.claim: أَشْتَاتًا can mark a crowd becoming separate responsibility units: portions are distinguished and distance or loss of union matters, rather than scattering being only unstructured disorder.
findings.mechanism: The scattering core and its distance facet meet the portion/group facet of ص د ر, while 99:7-8 changes the plural crowd into individually accountable persons and the supplied separation connections reinforce differentiated outcomes.
findings.reader_payoff: The verse's crowd movement acquires an adjudicative shape: separation prepares the people to be encountered and assessed as distinct units.
findings.containment: The packet supports partition and differentiated accountability, but does not decide whether the separation is spatial, social, moral, or simultaneously more than one of these.

epistemic.reason: Trusted focus support establishes the branch contact; legacy support and exact cross-ayah connections supply the individualized consequence while leaving the type of grouping open.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir arada bulunan kişilerin veya parçaların birlik düzenini yitirip birbirinden ayrılmasıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: أَشْتَاتًا carries people or parts losing a shared unity and separating.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The next two ayahs distribute the result across whoever does good or evil, and the Hour-separation connection supplies a distinct separation event.
branch_activations.activation: Scattering meets individualized outcome clauses, changing the crowd's separation from mere motion into preparation for distinct accountability.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The people leave as separated responsibility-bearing units.
branch_activations.boundary: No single spatial arrangement or exclusive moral-class reading is asserted.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: iki şey arasındaki büyük uzaklık ve uyuşmazlık
branch_activations.facet_statement: İki şey arasındaki uzaklığın veya ayrılığın çok büyük olduğu bildirilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The scattering branch includes great distance or separation between persons or parts.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied diverse-effort and individual-person connections make difference and separation consequential rather than incidental.
branch_activations.activation: The distance facet meets the singular accountability structure, so separated people are not only far apart but differentiated in outcome.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Scattering foregrounds a consequential distance between responsibility paths.
branch_activations.boundary: The connection does not prove a measurable physical distance or a total separation of all social relations.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bir şeyin bölümü ya da kümesi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin belirli olmayan bölümünü veya onun içindeki bir kümeyi belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: ص د ر/B006 carries a portion or cluster within a larger thing.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The plural people are called scattered, then the following ayahs address each individual person and deed.
branch_activations.activation: The portion/cluster facet contacts the scattered plural, providing a bounded group-unit reading before individual accounting.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The crowd can be seen as divided clusters or portions moving into separate accounts.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not determine the number, membership, or physical arrangement of the clusters.

findings.title: Work as an account
findings.claim: The focus works can carry an account-like pressure in which work is a consciously produced act, a task or charge, and a wage-like unit of return, while remaining ordinary works in the verse.
findings.mechanism: The focus branches connect ص د ر/B005's payment or guarantee obligation to ع م ل/B003's assigned task and ع م ل/B004's wage; 99:7-8 and the supplied exertion and repayment connections give that lexical field a consequence structure.
findings.reader_payoff: أَعْمَالَهُمْ is heard not only as deeds in the abstract but as output that can be counted, assigned, and returned to its producer.
findings.containment: This is an account or labor analogy grounded in registered facets; it does not translate the verse as employment, money, or a literal wage ledger.

epistemic.reason: Trusted support fixes the focus branch set, while legacy branch support and exact repayment/exertion connections activate the accounting frame with an explicit lexical boundary.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: para ödeme ve güvence yükümlülüğü koyma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kimseye belirli bir para tutarını ödeme ve o tutarın güvencesini üstlenme yükümlülüğü konur.
branch_activations.carrier: ص د ر/B005 carries an imposed payment and guarantee obligation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus names works as belonging to the people, and 46:19 supplies full repayment of what was earned.
branch_activations.activation: Obligation and repayment contact the work attribution, making the issuing people answerable for an output-like account.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The people emerge toward a return that has the pressure of an owed account.
branch_activations.boundary: The payment facet is an activated frame, not a claim that the verse describes literal currency.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: işe görevli kılma veya görev üstlenme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir iş üzerinde görev ve yetki üstlenme ana anlamdır.
branch_activations.carrier: عَمَل carries work undertaken under a task or responsibility.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The source/departure form and the following personal seeing connect the work to a responsible actor.
branch_activations.activation: Assigned-work language meets possessive attribution and later return, making the work a responsibility-bearing output.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: A person's work can be encountered as a charge for which that person is answerable.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not identify a human employer, formal institution, or worldly job.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İş karşılığı verilen ücret veya çalışanın payı ana anlamdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The work branch includes a wage or worker's share as an associated facet.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The paired ending weighs even minute deeds, while the supplied connections pair exertion with outcome and work with full repayment.
branch_activations.activation: A worker's-share facet contacts the measured return structure, making the works legible as units whose consequence is apportioned.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus anticipates a returned share or consequence attached to each person's work.
branch_activations.boundary: No positive reward, currency, or fixed conversion rate is assigned by this activation.

findings.title: Compelled self-display
findings.claim: The people no longer control how their work becomes visible: the act of displaying for others and the act of making others see are reversed into compulsory reception of the actor's own work.
findings.mechanism: The focus seeing branches distinguish acting so others see from causing another to see. The supplied display, public-giving, and hidden-observer connections provide the independent foil in which visibility is normally managed or withheld.
findings.reader_payoff: The passive purpose clause becomes an exposure of agency: the people are made recipients of visibility rather than directors of it.
findings.containment: This does not claim that the focus itself names hypocrisy, publicity, or a specific social audience; those are only contrastive triggers for the control boundary.

epistemic.reason: Trusted support supplies both registered seeing facets and the candidate's focus claim; the cross-ayah connections sharpen the control contrast without changing the lexical carrier.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir davranışı başkaları görsün ve beğensin diye sergileme.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus seeing root carries doing an act so others see it as a registered branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied display and public-giving connections depict visibility as something an actor may seek or manage.
branch_activations.activation: The managed-display facet is placed against the passive purpose of the focus, making the people receive visibility they no longer direct.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The verse exposes a reversal from voluntary display to compelled self-confrontation.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made that the focus people were previously hypocritical or seeking praise.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi başkasına gösterip onun görmesini sağlama.
branch_activations.carrier: The causative seeing facet makes another person see a displayed thing.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied hidden-observer connection shows the contrast between an actor's assumed privacy and an unavoidable observer, while 99:7-8 supply direct reception.
branch_activations.activation: Causative showing meets the passive purpose clause, so the people are positioned as the ones made to see rather than the ones arranging the audience.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Their own works are placed before them through a visibility they cannot manage.
branch_activations.boundary: The connection does not establish a literal audience, surveillance apparatus, or physical presentation.

findings.title: Ordered source departure
findings.claim: The registered ص د ر core and its water-source specialization let يَصْدُرُ describe an ordered departure after encounter: the scattered people leave a common station toward the purpose of having their works shown.
findings.mechanism: The source-departure core is retained together with its required specialization facet, while scattering, showing, intentional work, and supplied departure connections provide the independent trigger and the resulting accountability direction.
findings.reader_payoff: The people's coming out reads as a purposeful dispatch after a prior point of contact, not as unexplained random motion.
findings.containment: A prior gathering or arrival is abductive and not stated in the packet; the water scene is not literal here, and unresolved root_004965/B002 is excluded.

epistemic.reason: The focus branches and cross-ayah departure contacts are registered, but the prior encounter and common station are inferred rather than explicitly supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi başkasına gösterip onun görmesini sağlama.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus purpose clause carries causing the people to see their works.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The registered source-departure form and the legacy activation both connect departure to the purpose of showing.
branch_activations.activation: Showing supplies the destination and reason for the movement, preventing departure from becoming an unbounded motion claim.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The people depart under a disclosure purpose.
branch_activations.boundary: The purpose does not specify the complete sequence or a physical mechanism of transport.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir arada bulunan kişilerin veya parçaların birlik düzenini yitirip birbirinden ayrılmasıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: أَشْتَاتًا carries separation from a former shared order.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The source-departure and showing forms give the separated people a directed movement and purpose.
branch_activations.activation: Scattering becomes the form taken by an ordered dispatch toward disclosure, rather than an isolated lexical image of disorder.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The people leave in separated groups on a purposeful route to seeing.
branch_activations.boundary: No exact group count, route, or preceding assembly is supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Daha önce varılan bir yerden veya girilen bir durumdan ayrılıp geri yönelmeyi belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: يَصْدُرُ carries leaving and turning back from a place or entered situation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied watering-place departure connection gives an exact lexical parallel, while scattering and showing supply the focus situation.
branch_activations.activation: The focus movement is read as departure after an encountered station, directed by the purpose of showing works.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The issuing is a post-arrival departure rather than an unconditioned emergence.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not state that the people literally came to water or that a return to the same place occurs.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Su içmek için su başına gelen insan veya hayvanların oradan ayrılması temel örnektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The specialization carries the example of people or animals leaving a watering place after coming to drink.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact watering-place connection supplies the example, while the focus supplies people, scattering, and a showing purpose.
branch_activations.activation: The specialization gives the ordered departure a post-encounter image that clarifies sequence without becoming the verse's literal setting.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The people's issuing can be pictured as a directed release after a common encounter.
branch_activations.boundary: This analogical water image is not a direct translation, and no animal or watering-place scene is asserted.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem anlamı çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: أَعْمَالَهُمْ carries the deliberate works that furnish the departure's purpose.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The people depart to have these works shown, and the later clauses make the works individually seen.
branch_activations.activation: Intentional works give the ordered departure a defined destination and accountability content.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The dispatch is ordered toward confrontation with produced action.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not claim that deliberate agency explains every aspect of the movement.

findings.title: Inner source exposed
findings.claim: The people's issuing can be read as an inward source coming forward: question, knowledge, and intentional work that were inwardly held become available for seeing through the focus's movement and purpose.
findings.mechanism: The chest/source and intentional-work branches meet the selected 99:3-4 question and knowledge contacts, then connect to supplied inner-content and hidden-influence rows. The activation moves from inward source to visible work without making anatomy the claim.
findings.reader_payoff: The verse makes the outward movement carry a before-and-after contrast between hidden interior formation and visible accountable action.
findings.containment: This is a cross-ayah source analogy; it does not claim literal chest opening, that all inward states become visible, or that the unregistered ق و ل/B012 citation is a branch.

epistemic.reason: The focus carriers and supplied cross-ayah contacts are registered, but the transfer from inward source to visible action is inferential and the reader citation is unregistered.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsan ve hayvan gövdesinin boyun altındaki ön bölgesini belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: صَدْرُ carries the registered chest facet as an inward bodily source image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The selected context marks questioning and hidden knowledge, while the supplied connections treat the breast as a site of inward content or opening.
branch_activations.activation: The chest image gives a bounded bodily location for the inward-to-outward contrast in the surrounding sequence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The issuing can signal the surfacing of what was held inwardly.
branch_activations.boundary: The verse is not being translated as a literal anatomical opening or extraction.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem anlamı çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: أَعْمَالَهُمْ carries consciously produced acts that can be made visible.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The question and hidden-knowledge context supplies an inward formation field, and the hidden-influence connection links inner contents to action.
branch_activations.activation: Intentional work is the visible output through which an inward source can be read without equating intention and deed.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus joins inwardly formed responsibility to outwardly encountered work.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made that inward intention is fully knowable or identical to the resulting act.

findings.title: Moral bifurcation
findings.claim: The later paired good and evil clauses make أَشْتَاتًا open to differentiated moral or evidentiary paths, so the scattered people are not only spatially dispersed but divided into consequential kinds before their works are individually seen.
findings.mechanism: The registered scattering core supplies separation, while 99:7-8 mirrors the plural crowd with opposite singular outcomes and makes the focus purpose of showing works concrete. The supplied weighing connection reinforces differentiated consequence without activating an unregistered good-root branch.
findings.reader_payoff: The word for scattered people becomes a hinge into the surah's later sorting of tiny acts and their consequences.
findings.containment: Spatial scattering remains live; this finding does not assert that أَشْتَاتًا itself means moral classes, nor does it activate root_000452/B001 or claim that every type of grouping is resolved.

epistemic.reason: The focus scattering facet is registered, but the moral bifurcation is a bounded retrospective resonance supplied by later ayahs rather than a direct lexical gloss.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir arada bulunan kişilerin veya parçaların birlik düzenini yitirip birbirinden ayrılmasıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: أَشْتَاتًا carries separation of a formerly united group or set.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The paired 99:7-8 clauses divide the outcome into good and evil cases and then weigh each person's work.
branch_activations.activation: The later moral pairing gives the earlier scattering a differentiated consequence field while preserving its separation core.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Scattering can foreshadow the sorting of people and deeds into opposed paths.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not turn the focus adjective into a direct synonym for good and evil classes.

findings.title: Human-scale instability
findings.claim: The registered human-class branch allows the people to occupy the unstable middle between the earth's shaking and their scattering: collective human presence carries the disturbance forward at a human scale.
findings.mechanism: الناس supplies the human collective, while 99:1 supplies the preceding quake and the focus's أَشْتَاتًا supplies separation; the supplied scattered-people connection supports the bridge. The unresolved swaying branch is excluded, so the causal motion remains an inference.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus crowd is felt as a human response-stage between cosmic disturbance and individualized separation, not as a contextless population label.
findings.containment: The packet does not establish literal bodily swaying, a deterministic causal chain, or the unresolved root_004965/B001 sense; the reading is exploratory and qualified.

epistemic.reason: The human-class carrier is registered, but the motion from quake to human instability is inferred from the surrounding ayah and a legacy support whose second branch is unresolved.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: insan türü ve bu türden bir kişi
branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsan türünü, insanların oluşturduğu topluluğu veya bu türün tek bir üyesini görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında adlandırır.
branch_activations.carrier: الناس carries the human species or human collective in contrast with non-visible beings.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The surah's opening quake precedes the focus and the focus immediately places the people in a scattered state.
branch_activations.activation: The human collective becomes the intermediate carrier through which the preceding disturbance is imagined to reach social separation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Humanity appears as a collective body unsettled between shaken earth and separated accountability.
branch_activations.boundary: No unresolved swaying branch, literal bodily motion, or exclusive physical causation is claimed.

findings.title: Perceptual human subject
findings.claim: الناس can be heard as a human collective capable of receiving perception in the focus scene, because passive showing is followed by direct seeing of the work in 99:7-8.
findings.mechanism: The registered perception facet of the focus الناس carrier meets the focus's causative showing and the later direct-seeing clauses, with the exertion connection supplying an additional seen-result contact.
findings.reader_payoff: The people are not only the grammatical group that departs; they are the perceptual recipients through whom the disclosure becomes experienced.
findings.containment: The perception facet does not replace the human-class core, alter the collective grammar, or specify whether seeing is bodily or inward.

epistemic.reason: The perception branch is registered on the focus carrier and is independently activated by the later direct-seeing contrast, but the finding is uncandidate and remains a narrow contextual reading.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: görerek fark etme; bağlama göre işitme, sezme ve bakıp araştırma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi gözle görerek fark etmeyi veya seçmeyi anlatır.
branch_activations.carrier: The registered perception facet makes the human subject one who can notice or discern.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus makes the people see their works, and 99:7-8 makes each person directly see the result.
branch_activations.activation: The later seeing supplies an independent perceptual role for the people named at the focus without changing the noun's human-class identity.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The human collective is also the receiving subject of the disclosure.
branch_activations.boundary: No sensory modality beyond the registered seeing field and no singularization of the focus noun is claimed.

findings.title: Deed as exertion
findings.claim: أَعْمَالَهُمْ also admits a restrained effort or toil resonance: the works can carry the cost of exertion alongside their intentional-action sense.
findings.mechanism: The registered zahmete girme facet of ع م ل is carried by the focus work form and is independently contacted by 88:3's laboring-and-wearying description, while the focus possessive keeps the effort attributed to the people.
